lane: perf-tui-typing (wave-6 exploration: the TUI typing path decomposition)
hypothesis: Typing p50 3.67-3.86ms per keystroke (the scroll-retain2 parity legs' PTY-echo baseline, full-token scrolled 3.7-3.9ms) was never decomposed: either mechanism waste hides in the echo loop (read->dispatch->render->write) or the floor is the floor. The decomposition must separate INSTRUMENT cost from APP cost before any candidate exists - the same axis measured 1.53ms (bench compare.scroll_typing, official 5-trial suite) at the 20260925 tip and 0.5-0.8ms in that lane's PTYSession probe legs, so the number was instrument-dominated to an unknown degree.
approach: (1) CODE AUDIT at the current tip f3b524305 (origin/rust moved 5cf45d4d->46 merges->0e16d7671->2->f3b524305 during the lane; all three split series completed by then: session_ui 14/14 #2968, agent_engine 11/11 #2964, supervisor 8/8 #2963 - the moving-parts risk retired): the echo loop is interactive.rs's drain loop (per-key handle_key + an INLINE paint that bypasses the 16ms frame gate by design: 'the select below can otherwise wait out its 50ms tick... felt directly as keystroke-to-render lag'), app.rs draw() (terminal.size -> view.render_frame -> hyperlinks::install_frame -> take_osc_emissions -> execute!(BeginSynchronizedUpdate) -> ratatui terminal.draw closure (to_ratatui_line per row + full-grid render + diff + flush) -> queued caret MoveTo -> emit_zone_markers -> execute!(EndSynchronizedUpdate)), input.rs's reader thread (crossterm poll/read -> SequenceGuard -> forward -> ui_tx), the tokio::select loop (ui_rx arm -> pending queue). (2) PROBE BUILD (lane/hillclimb-tui-typing-decomp-probe, a2c325854 = tip + env-gated PA_TUI_ECHO_TRACE marks; PROBE-labeled, never ships, never a product baseline): 18 marks per keystroke across reader thread (reader_read/reader_key with the typed char), select loop (loop_recv), drain (dispatch_start/end, tray_start/end, draw_start/end) and draw internals (draw_enter/size/frame_built/links/osc/begin_w/ratatui/cursor_q/markers/end_w), each carrying CLOCK_REALTIME us + monotonic us + the char, joinable with the driver's stamps. Probe-build parity: P3 legs (trace off) vs P2 (base) p50 0.352/0.978 vs 1.038/1.056/1.029 - the bimodality is the reader-coalesced mode (below), not a probe artifact; trace ON adds nothing at p50 (P4 1.027/1.04/1.008). (3) FRESH VM ip9o9yy6kopg5ccz6ut2sa90 (16c/32GB ubuntu:22.04, rustup 1.98.1): base build (tip) sha 36d030c630938597449dc8ad557c000dd948e2961ca6896e6ffcccc1fc8d24df + probe build sha d124c72760e63f43b6530ab3a87ce603787828df235728a14a8d54a9bc1db419, sha-asserted swaps; bench-harness (PTYSession) + canonical fixtures (10MiB dadaecfc byte-identical assert per trial). outcome: discarded (honest negative: the floor is the floor - and the floor is ~0.38ms)
decision: WORKER RECOMMENDATION: DISCARD (no candidate, no PR). (1) The 3.67-3.86ms 'typing p50 baseline' was the POLL INSTRUMENT's own floor, not a product cost: the identical poll loop against `cat` (an instant echoer) reads 4.2ms p50 on the same VM - HIGHER than the product's 3.74-3.91 - because its screen_text() lock + pyte display build (0.755ms measured) + 2ms sleep quantize every reading at its own cycle; the baseline reproduced at the tip (P1) and is fully attributed. (2) The app's true echo path is ~0.38ms per keystroke (probe marks, 75 keys): reader wake 39us, guard/filter 7us, channel+tokio wake 25us, handle_key 27us, tray 1us, frame compose 45us, hyperlink install 14us, osc 6us, Begin write 6us, ratatui draw+flush 197us, tail 4us - the dominant segment is the ratatui full-grid render+diff (the double-buffer cost the 20260925 lane already named), and it is session-state independent (scrolled 1.06ms == at-ready 1.03ms on the grade instrument). (3) The grade instrument's ~1.03ms reading adds its OWN reader-side 0.65ms (the per-chunk pyte display build delays the paint-chunk stamp; the app's three-syscall flush sequence creates the two-chunk structure the reader trips over). (4) The TS anchor: the official TS beta pays 3.4-3.9ms per keystroke on the same VM/instrument (event-loop hops + full component render + whole-row diff), ~3.3x the Rust port's grade reading - the port is FASTER than its TS source on this axis. (5) CANDIDATES: none meet the bar. The two named micro-items - the 3 write+flush syscalls per keystroke frame (vs TS's single write; merging them keeps the byte stream identical) and the whole-grid re-render at 197us - are worth ~30us and ~100-150us respectively on an already-imperceptible 0.38ms path, under every instrument's noise floor, and sit on the parity-frozen TUI-output surface; the 20260925 lane's refutation of the same class stands. Headroom worth routing elsewhere: none on this axis - the typing path is decomposed, attributed, and at its floor.
